content.text: update the plannotator commands in @modules/home-manager/agents/files/commands/ to match latest in https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/tree/main/apps/opencode-plugin/commands

Assumptions: “match latest” means mirror the upstream command files at that URL, preserving this repo’s local file layout unless the upstream layout requires changes.

Plan:
1. Compare local command files with the upstream directory.
2. Copy only the needed command updates.
3. Review the diff and run the repo’s validation script.

input.command:
set -e
for file in plannotator-annotate.md plannotator-last.md plannotator-review.md; do
  diff -u "/tmp/pi-github-repos/backnotprop/plannotator@main/apps/opencode-plugin/commands/$file" "modules/home-manager/agents/files/commands/$file"
done
git diff --check
printf '%s\n' '--- git diff ---'
git diff -- modules/home-manager/agents/files/commands
